text:
Maya R.: Heads-up — noticed two issues in the Optimize toolkit doc: the quantization profile table uses the old profile names (q4_0_old) and the SDK snippet link at the bottom 404s.
Samir: Oof, thanks. Which page exactly?
Maya R.: /docs/optimize/toolkit/batching-caching.md — under 'Quantization profiles' header and the 'SDK examples' section. The SDK link points to /sdk/v0.8/examples which no longer exists.
Samir: I'll open a quick PR to fix the link. Probably should point to /sdk/latest/examples. PR #4721 incoming.
Nina: We also need a migration note for customers who used the old profile names — people will paste the old name and get weird perf regressions.
Eli: Agreed. Suggested text: "Note: profile names changed in v0.9. Map q4_0_old -> q4_0, q8_0_old -> q8_0. If you see increased token latency after migrating, verify your quantization profile mapping." Want me to add that to the PR?
Samir: Yes please add it. Also can you update the example SDK snippet to the new API shape? Current snippet still uses the legacy call `optimize.set_profile("q4_0_old")`.
Eli: New snippet I tested locally:
```
from redwood import optimize
opt = optimize.configure(
  batching={"max_batch_tokens": 2048, "max_concurrent": 4},
  caching={"enable_prefix_cache": True, "ttl_seconds": 300},
  quant_profile="q4_0"
)
```
Replace the inline example with that and add a one-line explanation for `ttl_seconds`.
Devex: Also add a short note about dynamic batching caveat: "If your request size variance is high, set `max_concurrent` lower to prevent head-of-line blocking." Small paragraph under batching tips.
Maya R.: Good call. For the 404 link — Samir, can PR also update the link target and add a redirect in the docs nav? We get a lot of inbound links from the migration guide.
Samir: Will do. I'll also run the staging build and paste preview URL here when ready.
docs-bot: Preview build for PR #4721: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/pr-4721 — build passed ✅
Nina: Preview looks fine. I pushed a tiny wording tweak to the quant note: added migration example mapping table.
Eli: One more thing — the cache example earlier uses `prefix_cache` in text but `enable_prefix_cache` in code. Align naming to `enable_prefix_cache` (that's what the SDK expects now).
Maya R.: Great catch. Please make those alignment changes.
Samir: Updated PR: changed names, fixed link, added migration note and dynamic batching caveat, replaced SDK snippet with Eli's code, aligned cache flag.
Devex: Can we add a short example showing how to verify that caching is active? Maybe curl a metrics endpoint: `GET /metrics?filter=cache_hits` and look for `prefix_cache_hits`.
Samir: Added a one-liner under caching diagnostics.
Maya R.: Reviewing now. If all good I'll merge after lunch. Thanks everyone :pray:
Eli: Quick runbook suggestion — add a one-line regression alert rule in the Optimize console docs: "Alert if prefix_cache_hit_rate < 0.2 for 10m". Saves support tickets later.
Maya R.: Love it. Add as follow-up if PR gets heavy — otherwise include in same PR.
Samir: Lightweight; I added it.
Maya R.: All set, merging in 15. Marking this thread resolved once merged.
docs-bot: PR #4721 merged by samir — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4721
Maya R.: Thanks all! :tada:
